mapper.sql: select l.lead_id, l.lead_type, l.opty_id, l.opty_name, l.org_id, l.lead_name, l.full_name, l.owner, l.contact_id, l.contact_name, l.stage, l.work_phone, l.mobile_phone, l.work_email, l.lead_source, l.lead_rating, l.website, l.territory, l.industry, l.employee_count, l.revenue, l.description, l.days_inactive, l.partner, l.convert_time, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, l.user_id, l.dept_id, l.province, l.city, l.sid, l.custom_field, l.wechat_mp_openid, l.wechat_mp_app_id, l.wecom_external_userid, l.wecom_follow_userid, l.number_of_founders, l.funders, l.funders_title, l.number_of_funding_rounds, l.last_funding_type, l.total_funding_amount, l.funding_currency, l.founded_at, l.status, l.last_followup_at, l.assigned_at, l.short_description, l.avatar, l.tag, l.survey_json, w.wecom_state from crm_lead l left join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join ( select crm_lead_id, min(state) as wecom_state from crm_wecom_external_contact where crm_lead_id is not null and trim(crm_lead_id) <> '' group by crm_lead_id ) w on w.crm_lead_id = l.lead_id

select lead_id, lead_type, opty_id, opty_name, org_id, lead_name, full_name, owner, contact_id, contact_name, stage, work_phone, mobile_phone, work_email, lead_source, lead_rating, website, territory, industry, employee_count, revenue, description, days_inactive, partner, convert_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, user_id, dept_id, province, city, sid, custom_field, wechat_mp_openid, wechat_mp_app_id, wecom_external_userid, wecom_follow_userid, number_of_founders, funders, funders_title, number_of_funding_rounds, last_funding_type, total_funding_amount, funding_currency, founded_at, status, last_followup_at, assigned_at, short_description, avatar, tag, survey_json from crm_lead
mapper.select:
SELECT l.lead_id, l.lead_type, l.opty_id, l.opty_name, l.org_id, l.lead_name, l.full_name, l.owner, l.contact_id, o.contact_name, o.stage, o.work_phone, l.mobile_phone, l.work_email, l.lead_source, l.lead_rating, l.website, l.territory, l.industry, l.employee_count, l.revenue, l.description, l.days_inactive, l.partner, l.convert_time, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, l.user_id, l.dept_id, l.province, l.city, l.sid, l.custom_field, l.number_of_founders, l.funders, l.funders_title, l.number_of_funding_rounds, l.last_funding_type, l.total_funding_amount, l.funding_currency, l.founded_at, l.status, l.short_description, l.avatar from crm_lead l left join crm_opty o on o.lead_id=l.lead_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id
${params.dataScope}
where lead_id = #{leadId}
where lead_id = #{leadId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert:
insert into crm_lead
lead_id, lead_type, opty_id, opty_name, org_id, lead_name, full_name, owner, contact_id, contact_name, stage, work_phone, mobile_phone, work_email, lead_source, lead_rating, website, territory, industry, employee_count, revenue, description, days_inactive, partner, convert_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, province, city, user_id, dept_id, sid, custom_field, wechat_mp_openid, wechat_mp_app_id, wecom_external_userid, wecom_follow_userid, number_of_founders, funders, funders_title, number_of_funding_rounds, last_funding_type, total_funding_amount, funding_currency, founded_at, status, last_followup_at, assigned_at, short_description, avatar, tag, survey_json,
#{leadId}, #{leadType}, #{optyId}, #{optyName}, #{orgId}, #{leadName}, #{fullName}, #{owner}, #{contactId}, #{contactName}, #{stage}, #{workPhone}, #{mobilePhone}, #{workEmail}, #{leadSource}, #{leadRating}, #{website}, #{territory}, #{industry}, #{employeeCount}, #{revenue}, #{description}, #{daysInactive}, #{partner}, #{convertTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{province}, #{city}, #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{sid}, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(#{customField}), '') AS jsonb), #{wechatMpOpenid}, #{wechatMpAppId}, #{wecomExternalUserid}, #{wecomFollowUserid}, #{numberOfFounders}, #{funders}, #{fundersTitle}, #{numberOfFundingRounds}, #{lastFundingType}, #{totalFundingAmount}, #{fundingCurrency}, #{foundedAt}, #{status}, #{lastFollowupAt}, #{assignedAt}, #{shortDescription}, #{avatar}, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(#{tag}), '') AS jsonb), CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(#{surveyJson}), '') AS jsonb),
mapper.delete:
delete from crm_lead where lead_id in
#{leadId}
mapper.select:
WHERE l.wecom_external_userid IN
#{id}
WHERE l.mobile_phone = #{mobilePhone} AND LOWER(TRIM(l.status)) IN ('initial', 'assigned') ORDER BY l.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
WHERE l.mobile_phone = #{mobilePhone} AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(l.status, ''))) IN ('initial', 'assigned', 'open') ORDER BY l.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_lead WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND lower(trim(coalesce(status, ''))) = 'assigned'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_lead WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND lower(trim(coalesce(status, ''))) IN ('open', 'assigned')

SELECT l.lead_id, l.status, l.user_id, l.owner, l.mobile_phone, l.last_followup_at, l.assigned_at, l.create_time FROM crm_lead l WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(l.status, ''))) = 'assigned' AND l.user_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(l.last_followup_at, l.assigned_at, l.create_time) < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{idleHours} || ' hours')::interval) ORDER BY COALESCE(l.last_followup_at, l.assigned_at, l.create_time) ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT user_id FROM crm_lead WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(status, ''))) = 'assigned' AND user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > #{maxHold}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_lead SET status = #{status}, user_id = #{userId}, dept_id = #{deptId}, owner = #{owner}, wecom_follow_userid = #{wecomFollowUserid}, assigned_at = #{assignedAt}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE lead_id = #{leadId}
mapper.select: WHERE l.contact_id = #{contactId} AND lower(trim(coalesce(l.status, ''))) = 'assigned' ORDER BY l.assigned_at DESC NULLS LAST, l.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
WHERE l.wecom_external_userid = #{wecomExternalUserid} AND lower(trim(coalesce(l.status, ''))) = 'assigned' ORDER BY l.assigned_at DESC NULLS LAST, l.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
where l.contact_id = #{contactId} and lower(trim(coalesce(l.status, ''))) = 'converted' order by l.convert_time desc nulls last limit 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.contact_id, c.name, c.mobile_phone, c.work_phone, c.birthdate, c.account_name, c.gender, c.user_id, c.wecom_external_userid, c.wecom_follow_userid, c.full_name, c.org_id, c.account_id, c.salutation, c.title, c.marital_status, c.birthDate, c.age, c.personal_email, c.client_type, c.territory, c.owner, c.management_level, c.department, c.reports_to, c.reports_to_id, c.favorability_rating, c.influence_rating, c.assistant, c.assistant_phone, c.assistant_email, c.allow_call, c.allow_email, c.is_customer, c.is_org_customer, c.responsibility, c.active_opty_count, c.active_lead_count, c.active_opty_amount, c.status, c.working_years, c.is_active, c.degree, c.major, c.origin, c.original_source, c.sid, c.source_lead_id, c.first_visit_clinic_id, c.imaging_portal_url, c.imaging_patient_external_id, c.first_visit_at, c.last_visit_at, c.visit_count, c.acquisition_cost, c.wecom_name, c.wecom_avatar, c.wecom_gender, c.wecom_type, c.wechat, c.location, c.school, c.tag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.user_id, c.dept_id, c.custom_field, c.resources, c.requirement, c.rr_description, c.name_card, c.avatar, c.priority FROM crm_contact c JOIN crm_lead l ON l.contact_id = c.contact_id WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(l.status, ''))) = 'converted' AND l.convert_time::date = CURRENT_DATE - #{daysAfter}
